hook_default_id.about: a hook line without an id gets h_<run>:<seq>, never <run>:<seq>, which only collectors use

reserved_ids.about: h_<run>:<seq> is the hook default namespace; another origin that sends such an id gets the plain sha256 form

files_about: activity.md, Files. files: the event's `files` on the example `base`; schema: valid against activity.schema.json; stored: what the writer keeps (null = no files field; bad entries dropped, the line kept). NFC is checked by the writer, not the schema.

files.name: colon after a folder is fine

record_auth.about: Record MAC (activity.md, Authenticated record). Keys are fixed TEST values, never real. `lines` are the exact bytes of each file line (newline included) as hex; a case's file is their concatenation. expect.shown lists the seq of the events a reader shows. Replayed by contracts/validate.py (stdlib hmac only) and workspace/tests/test_record_auth.py (orch.record_auth).
